title: Russia and Ukraine hold first US-brokered peace talks since February in Abu Dhabi
caption:
Russian and Ukrainian negotiators met in Abu Dhabi on Tuesday for their first US-brokered talks since February, with envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner mediating. Kyiv wants security guarantees and prisoner exchanges, while Moscow still demands all of Donbas. Talks continue on Wednesday, and the US reportedly wants Europe at the table for the next round.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
